classification: Original selected device privacy preference and outbound client workflow; no native server or visual compatibility

preference.coerce: strict false alone disables; every other decoded value enables

storage.read: runtime fallback first; otherwise getItem catch->null; absent/malformed JSON->undefined before coerce; cache parsed value by exact raw string
storage.write: coerce first; JSON stringify before setItem try; successful write clears fallback, failed write stores runtime fallback; dispatch local event regardless
storage.remove: swallow remove error, clear decoded/fallback caches, dispatch local event
storage.persistence: working browser storage persists across reload; runtime fallback is not durable
storage.subscriptions: lazy storage/local-storage listeners; null/undefined event key notifies selected key, exact key notifies it, other key ignored; callback unsubscribe does not detach module-lifetime listeners
storage.externalEvent: notify only; does not clear write-failure fallback

outbound.normalize: trim; protocol-relative gains https:, non-http(s)-prefix gains https://; URL must resolve to https:; malformed/empty returns null
outbound.trustedComparison: normalize and remove one www. prefix, then exact hostname set
outbound.request: invalid leaves state; trusted or no confirmation opens directly without clearing any existing dialog; otherwise reset checkbox, retain normalized URL, open dialog
outbound.confirm: when pending URL exists, feature-enabled AND checked writes false before open; then close and clear URL; popup return ignored
outbound.cancel: close and clear URL; checkbox is reset by the next prompted request

limits: Selected device preference only; no account ownership/session partition, remote preference endpoint or backend inference.
All four hook and three consumer variants remain explicit; no active page winner is inferred.
UI rendering, React scheduling/hydration, popup policies and arbitrary reentrant application-port changes are outside the controller's settled-state model.
Explicit storage/events/window-open ports; no production navigation, browser permission request, analytics service or implicit network.
The source trusted-host list is preserved as client behavior, not a security clearance or scope expansion into excluded destinations.
The device Settings row is local UI integration; modal dismissal and shared shell remain distinct. No visual parity, native compatibility or feature-ledger credit.
Direct imports retain all available inventory variants; complete transitive closure remains unresolved.
